claims.quote: The highest responder rate, which occurred among patients with mutations in the solute carrier family 2 member 1 gene, SLC2A1 (n = 87), was 96% (95% CI, 91%-100%, I2 = 0%, P = .72)
The highest seizure-free rate, which occurred in patients with mutations in SLC2A1 (n = 80), was 67% (95% CI, 49%-86%, I2 = 78%, P < .01)
